mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over the next month predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >70% of similar inflation spikes (p-value > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS rises by more than 10,000 jobs compared to the prior month, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days tend to be positive as labor market strength supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, mean 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) during such labor gains.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO index below 104.0 suggests weakening manufacturing capacity, which is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: No significant negative returns in 20-day windows following INDPRO declines (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly HOUST falls by at least 5% from the prior month, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days are expected to be negative due to reduced demand for equities.
failure_condition: 20-day rolling mean return is positive during such demand shocks (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS (below 2.0%) with no reversal triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as markets anticipate further easing.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are non-positive in >50% of such episodes (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE increases by more than 0.1 percentage points over the next month, the S&P 500 20-day forward return tends to be positive due to expectations of wage growth supporting equities.
failure_condition: Mean 20-day return is negative during such UNRATE increases (p-value < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their prior month levels predict a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to dual demand signals.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically positive (p-value > 0.05) when both proxies rise simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of persistent industrial overcapacity (INDPRO < 103.0 for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 60-day forward return is expected to be negative due to supply-side weakness.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >50% of such episodes (p-value > 0.05).
